accounting_reserves.rule: These reserves are inside the unchanged global totals. Linux stage allocations sum to 550 CPU-seconds and 751 wall-seconds. The Linux child process tree is counted once: the WSL launcher RUSAGE_CHILDREN measurement is authoritative and the supervisor self-plus-child value is only a consistency check. The single CPU second outside stage allocations is reserved for measured Windows post-preflight work; the two wall seconds cover cross-system return and settlement. No stage can borrow another stage's allocation.
